sample.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where’s Natsuki?”

Yuri: “Maybe she overslept? I don’t know. But still, I can’t believe Natsuki’s unborn baby girl - Sakura - is getting so big.”

Sayori: “Yeah, she’s just growing like a sunflower! And I can understand why Natsuki would take a power nap - she’s like, what, 8 months pregnant? 7 months? 6 months?! Jeez, I lost track of how far along she is.”

(Just then, Natsuki enters the clubroom, clearing her throat.)

Natsuki: “**9** months, Sayori.”
sample.chosen:
Natsuki: "And I wasn't oversleeping, I was just taking a moment to rest. Being this far along in pregnancy can be quite tiring, you know."

Monika: "Of course, Natsuki. We understand. Is there anything we can do to help you feel more comfortable?"

Yuri: "Yes, please let us know if there's anything you need. We want to make sure you and Sakura are both doing well."

Sayori: "Absolutely! And Natsuki, I'm sorry for losing track of how far along you are. I didn't mean to upset you."

Natsuki: "It's okay, Sayori. I know you didn't mean any harm. And thank you all for your concern. I really appreciate it."

(The girls continue their conversation, making sure to be mindful of Natsuki's needs and offering their support as she prepares for the arrival of her baby girl, Sakura.)
sample.rejected: Natsuki: "And I didn't oversleep, I was just... practicing my labor breathing exercises. You know, in case the little one decides to make an early appearance."
